svg.title: The recommended 0603 footprint
svg.desc: Enlarged and drawn to scale. The recommended 0603 (1608 metric) footprint: two pads 0.7 mm long and 1.0 mm wide on a 1.4 mm pitch, leaving a 0.7 mm gap. The 1.6 × 0.8 mm part sits with both metal ends on the pads.

g.text: Enlarged and drawn to scale. Dimensions in mm.
Footprint from the table in PCB-DFA-029.
